{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 116,
      "where": "Paragraph preceding (2.5.1.2)",
      "scan": "les foncteur Gr_n",
      "tex": "les foncteur $\\Gr_n$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "les foncteurs $\\Gr_n$",
      "note": "The print omits the plural s in «foncteurs»; the TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 117,
      "where": "2.5.2, definition of K_B^+(F(A))",
      "scan": "sont les complexes X^{\\bigdot}",
      "tex": "sont les complexe $X^{\\bigdot}$",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "sont les complexe $X^{\\bigdot}$",
        "new": "sont les complexes $X^{\\bigdot}$"
      },
      "note": "The printed noun is plural."
    },
    {
      "page": 117,
      "where": "2.5.2, definition of D_B^+F(A)",
      "scan": "H^i(\\Gr_j(X^{\\bigdot})) \\in B",
      "tex": "H^j(\n\\Gr_j(X^{\\bigdot})) \\in B",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "H^j(\n\\Gr_j(X^{\\bigdot}))",
        "new": "H^i(\n\\Gr_j(X^{\\bigdot}))"
      },
      "note": "The cohomological exponent is i in print, not j."
    },
    {
      "page": 117,
      "where": "2.5.2, paragraph beginning «Le foncteur oubli des filtrations»",
      "scan": "\\iota(K^+_B(F(A)) \\subset K^+_B(A)",
      "tex": "\\iota(K^+_B (F(A))\n\\subset K^+_B (A)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\iota(K^+_B(F(A))) \\subset K^+_B(A)",
      "note": "The print lacks the closing parenthesis for the argument of \\iota; the TeX keeps this omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 117,
      "where": "Proposition 2.5.3, factorization display, source category",
      "scan": "D^{+}(\\underline{\\Gamma}(S\\times D),\\mathcal{O}_S)",
      "tex": "D^{+} (\\Gamma (S \\times D), \\mathcal{O}_S)",
      "kind": "font",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "D^{+} (\\Gamma (S \\times D), \\mathcal{O}_S)",
        "new": "D^{+} (\\Ysheaf{\\Gamma} (S \\times D), \\mathcal{O}_S)"
      },
      "note": "The mathematical underline on Γ identifies the category of sections; it is not textual emphasis."
    },
    {
      "page": 117,
      "where": "Proposition 2.5.3, first arrow of the factorization",
      "scan": "{}_F\\RR^+\\varepsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}",
      "tex": "F^{\\sisi{\\RR^+}{R}\n\\varepsilon} Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "F^{\\sisi{\\RR^+}{R}\n\\varepsilon} Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast",
        "new": "{}_F\\sisi{\\RR^+}{R}\\varepsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "In print F is the left subscript of the derived functor, and Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast is the subscript of ε. The TeX instead makes the derived functor an exponent of F and detaches its index."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Opening triangular diagram, downward arrow",
      "scan": "{}_F\\RR^{+}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}",
      "tex": "F^{\\sisi{\\RR^{+}}{R}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "F^{\\sisi{\\RR^{+}}{R}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}}",
        "new": "{}_F\\sisi{\\RR^{+}}{R}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The print uses a left-subscript F on the derived functor, not F with that functor as its exponent."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Proof of 2.5.3, before (2.5.3.1)",
      "scan": "on muni",
      "tex": "on muni",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "on munit",
      "note": "The print omits the final t of «munit»; the TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.3.3), top horizontal arrow",
      "scan": "\\RR^{+}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}",
      "tex": "R\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}}\\ast",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "R\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}}\\ast",
        "new": "\\RR^{+}\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The print has R^{+}, and the star belongs in ε's subscript rather than at the main baseline."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.3.3), arrow from D^+F(S,O_S) to D^+(S,O_S)",
      "scan": "\\iota",
      "tex": "\\imath",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\ar[ru]_{\\imath}",
        "new": "\\ar[ru]_{\\iota}"
      },
      "note": "The printed label is the Greek iota denoting the forgetful functor, not dotless Latin i."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.3.3), arrow from K^+(F(S,O_S)) to K^+(S,O_S)",
      "scan": "\\iota",
      "tex": "\\imath",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\ar[rd]^{\\imath}",
        "new": "\\ar[rd]^{\\iota}"
      },
      "note": "This printed forgetful-functor label is also Greek iota."
    },
    {
      "page": 118,
      "where": "Diagram (2.5.3.3), bottom horizontal arrow",
      "scan": "K^{+}(\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast})",
      "tex": "K^{+}(\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}}\\ast)",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "K^{+}(\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}}\\ast)",
        "new": "K^{+}(\\epsilon_{Z^{\\bigdot}\\ast})"
      },
      "note": "The printed star is part of ε's subscript."
    },
    {
      "page": 120,
      "where": "Opening spectral-sequence formula",
      "scan": "\\circ\\LL^{+}\\theta_p^{\\ast}\\longrightarrow R^{p+q}H_{\\ast}",
      "tex": "\\circ\n\\theta^{\\ast}_p \\longrightarrow R^{p+q}H_{\\ast}",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\theta^{\\ast}_p \\longrightarrow R^{p+q}H_{\\ast}",
        "new": "\\LL^{+}\\theta^{\\ast}_p \\longrightarrow R^{p+q}H_{\\ast}"
      },
      "note": "The print includes the derived inverse-image operator L^{+} before θ_p^{\\ast}."
    },
    {
      "page": 120,
      "where": "Sentence immediately following (2.5.5.2)",
      "scan": "est essentiellement commutatif. (…)",
      "tex": "est essentiellement commutatif car",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "est essentiellement commutatif car\n$$",
        "new": "est essentiellement commutatif.\n$$\n("
      },
      "note": "The print has a complete sentence followed by a parenthetical explanation, without «car». Apply together with the closing-parenthesis edit in the following finding."
    },
    {
      "page": 120,
      "where": "Explanatory display following (2.5.5.2), final factor",
      "scan": "\\RR^+\\bar{\\theta}_{\\ast}\\circ\\LL^{+}\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast})",
      "tex": "\\sisi{\\RR^+}{R} \\bar{\\theta}_\\ast \\circ\n\\bar{\\theta}_\\ast{\\quoi}.",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\bar{\\theta}_\\ast{\\quoi}.",
        "new": "\\LL^{+}\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}){\\quoi}."
      },
      "note": "The final factor in print is the derived inverse image L^{+}\\bar{\\theta}^{\\ast}, not another direct image. This edit also closes the printed parenthetical explanation."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "Counts (normal/misprint): 116: 0/1; 117: 4/1; 118: 5/1; 119: 0/0; 120: 3/0.\nApply the two p.120 edits restoring the parenthetical explanation together: its opening follows «commutatif», and its closing follows the final inverse-image functor."
}
